name: What is the timeline for constructing and installing a landlord-ready tiny home?

mainEntity.name: What is the timeline for constructing and installing a landlord-ready tiny home?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for a landlord-ready tiny home project typically involves several phases. Design and permitting can take a few weeks to several months, depending on local regulations and the complexity of your plans. Construction usually takes between 8 to 16 weeks, varying by design and materials. Site preparation and installation follow, which can add a few weeks. Overall, projects can range from 4 to 9 months from initial design to move-in readiness. We strive to keep you informed at every stage.
acceptedAnswer.description: Construction and installation of a landlord-ready tiny home can take 4-9 months, including design, permitting, building, and site work.
